title: Hello, I'm Anna! — VOA Lesson 2
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 1 Lesson 2. Original VOA conversation audio and dialogue. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.text: She is Anna. She is new to D.C.
dialogue.translation_ar: إنها آنا. هي جديدة في واشنطن.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I am from a small town.

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.text: I am Jonathan. I am in apartment B4.
dialogue.translation_ar: أنا جوناثان، أسكن في الشقة B4.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I am in apartment C2. Marsha is my roommate.
dialogue.translation_ar: أنا في الشقة C2، ومارشا شريكتي في السكن.

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.text: I know Marsha. She is nice.

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.text: And I am in Apartment D7. I have to go now.
dialogue.translation_ar: وأنا في الشقة D7. يجب أن أذهب الآن.

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.text: Remember to call Marsha at work. Tell her you’re here.
dialogue.translation_ar: تذكري الاتصال بمارشا في العمل. أخبريها أنك وصلتِ.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Right, thanks, Pete. Nice to meet you!
dialogue.translation_ar: حسنًا، شكرًا يا بيت. سُررت بلقائك!
